newsitem.title: USA: MMI, UNIONAMERICA RATINGS UNDER REVIEW.
newsitem.headline: MMI, UNIONAMERICA RATINGS UNDER REVIEW.

text.p: Insurance rating firm A.M. Best Co said on Wednesday it has placed the "A" (Excellent) rating of MMI Cos Inc and the "A-" (Excellent) rating of Unionamerica Insurance Co Ltd under review with developing implications.
The rating action follows MMI's announcement that it has signed an acquisition agreement in connection with the proposed stock swap acquisition of Unionamerica Holdings Plc, Unionamerica's parent.

The ratings will remain under review pending the completion of the transaction and A.M. Best's review of the integration plans and consolidated financial condition of the combined entities, A.M. Best said in a statement.
